summary: Cartesian Therapeutics filed a Form 8-K under Items 7.01, 8.01 and 9.01 disclosing a press release with additional Phase 2 retreatment data for Descartes-08 in myasthenia gravis. Five participants who relapsed after 12-month follow-up were retreated at a median of 16.6 months; retreated patients averaged a 6.6-point MG-ADL and 15-point MGC reduction at Month 12, with four maintaining clinically meaningful MG-ADL benefit. No new safety signals, serious adverse events, CRS, ICANS, cytopenias or hypogammaglobulinemia occurred. This is a routine clinical data disclosure, not a special situation; no deal terms, advisors or board recommendations apply. Watch pipeline/regulatory catalysts rather than arbitrage.
